digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: गाजा डील पर ईरान का बड़ा बयान आया है। ईरान ने कहा कि वह हमास के कदमों का समर्थन करेगा। भारत के दोस्त और जहाज पर ईरान ने अटैक किया है।

articles.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
articles.summary: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

articles.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
articles.summary: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

articles.title: Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile, Drone Attack On Kyiv Region
articles.summary: Russia launched a massive overnight attack on Kyiv and the surrounding region with ballistic missiles and drones. At least 17 people were killed, including eight near a train station outside Brovary. The strikes also destroyed major warehouse owned by Ukrainian retailer Epicentr. Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile, Drone Attack On Kyiv Region.

articles.title: ​How misinformation and ​a​ hardened immigration policy ​turned Ceuta ​into Europe’s ​latest
articles.summary: In today’s newsletter: The past week shows how quickly images, rumours and ​right-wing political opportunism can eclipse the facts on the groundGood morning. Last week, an estimated 72,000 migrants began crossing into a tiny Spanish enclave on the tip of Morocco. Within 24 hours, most of them had headed home. At least 88 people died after attempting the crossing, according to local officials.

articles.title: Hundreds in Morocco gather near Ceuta border in anxious wait for missing loved ones
articles.summary: People hope to see friends or relatives among those still returning as death toll from mass crossing nears 100Hundreds of people have gathered in the northern Moroccan town of Fnideq, near the border with Spain’s Ceuta, flashing photos of their missing loved ones to passersby in the hope of tracking them down. Hundreds in Morocco gather near Ceuta border in anxious wait for missing loved ones.

articles.title: New Zealand capital delights in rare snowfall as southern city residents ski down world’s steepest
articles.summary: Snow falls in Wellington for the first time in 15 years while snow blanketed Dunedin and Christchurch on the country’s south islandTemperatures have plummeted across New Zealand as an Antarctic cold snap hovers over the country, delighting the capital, Wellington, which experienced snow for the first time in 15 years, while giving a southern city’s residents a chance to ski through the streets.

articles.title: Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'
articles.summary: In an interview with RFE/RL, Republican Senator Rick Scott said Russian President Vladimir Putin did not anticipate the strength of US support for Ukraine's war effort, adding that a new sanctions bill is meant to hold Russia accountable. Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'.

articles.title: ' Senator Rick Scott Says Congress Must Hold Russia Accountable
articles.summary: Influential Republican Senator Rick Scott talks to RFE/RL about why he believes sanctions against Russia should be passed immediately, why Ukraine's military innovations matter for the United States, and why defeating Russia is central to deterring an increasingly coordinated authoritarian bloc. ' Senator Rick Scott Says Congress Must Hold Russia Accountable.

articles.title: US in a losing race to replenish depleted missile arsenals
articles.summary: The US’s multibillion-dollar push to expand interceptor missile production could begin rebuilding depleted stocks, but long manufacturing lead times, industrial bottlenecks and cost imbalances mean the benefits will depend on how quickly new capacity translates into deployable missiles. The US Department of Defense (DoD) signed framework agreements worth over US$3 billion with defense contractors US in a losing race to replenish depleted missile arsenals.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike 'Russia's Amazon' Near St. Petersburg
articles.summary: Russian authorities claim Ukrainian drones hit multiple Wildberries warehouses in several regions on August 4. Officials reported damage at facilities near St. Petersburg, and in the Tver and Moscow regions. Ukraine's drone commander said at least 15 Wildberries hubs have been hit since mid-July. Ukrainian Drones Strike 'Russia's Amazon' Near St. Petersburg.

articles.title: Africans bear the brunt of biodiversity loss
articles.summary: For millions across Africa and the developing world, the biodiversity crisis is not an abstract problem – it’s the soil that no longer yields bountiful harvests and the fish that no longer return to coastal waters. Africans bear the brunt of biodiversity loss.

articles.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war
articles.summary: As Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues, with both sides stepping up airstrikes and drone attacks in recent weeks deep inside each other's territory, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) appealed on Tuesday for greater protection for the war’s youngest victims. ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war.

articles.title: New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo
articles.summary: Results may be months away, but efforts are advancing towards enhanced treatment and the world’s first vaccine for the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday as deaths and cases rise in the largest ever outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo.

articles.title: Russian Drone Hunts Down Market Vendor In Kherson
articles.summary: Ukrainian National Police have published a video they say shows a Russian drone stalking and attacking a man selling goods at a market in the city of Kherson. The 52-year-old survived but suffered blast trauma, concussion, and shrapnel wounds, according to authorities. Russian Drone Hunts Down Market Vendor in Kherson. Ukrainian police have published a video they say shows a Russian drone stalking and attacking a man selling goods at a market in the city of Kherson.

articles.title: Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leave Five Dead
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck two more warehouses used by the online retailer Wildberries, as well as a third in the Moscow region that killed five people as Russia and Ukraine continued exchanging cross-border strikes with US-mediated peace talks stalled. Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leaves 5 Dead. Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leave Five Dead.

articles.title: Colombia swears in costumed anti-corruption activist as senator
articles.summary: Luis Carlos Rúa revealed himself to be Elefante blanco just three days before election for ‘his own safety’. Now he is tackling graft from senate floorWhen 102 senators were sworn in for Colombia’s latest parliamentary session, they included 32 women, 69 men – and one cartoon elephant. Colombia swears in costumed anti-corruption activist as senator.

articles.title: Japan’s prime minister tours earthquake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring
articles.summary: Prime minister Sanae Takaichi visited Kumamoto prefecture almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 quake hit, killing 38 peopleJapan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, has visited the south-western prefecture of Kumamoto, where recovery efforts are being hampered by heat and a lack of water supplies, almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake killed dozens and caused widespread damage. Thirty-eight p Japan’s prime minister tours quake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring temperatures.

articles.title: Stronger EU borders needed after Ceuta crisis, von der Leyen says
articles.summary: European Commission president says work needed in five areas of migration control including returning more peopleThe president of the European Commission has called for action to strengthen Europe’s borders after tens of thousands of people arrived and quickly left the Spanish territory of Ceuta, triggering a furious row between Madrid and other European countries. Stronger EU borders needed after Ceuta crisis, von der Leyen says.

articles.title: How Ceuta migrant crisis exposes divisions within Europe
articles.summary: Dozens of people died attempting to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after an estimated 50,000 crossed from Morocco last week. The incident has led to a political crisis in Spain and criticism from EU countries. Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s European community affairs correspondent, Ashifa Kassam – watch on YouTube Continue reading How Ceuta migrant crisis exposes divisions within Europe.

articles.title: Beyond the Singularity: China owning the physical AI revolution
articles.summary: The global discourse on artificial intelligence is preoccupied with a dramatic possibility: The Singularity, the moment a disembodied artificial general intelligence awakens in a server farm, escapes human control and either elevates or destroys civilization. This is largely a software-centered vision of the future, shaped by a culture that tends to imagine intelligence as something [] The post B Beyond the Singularity: China owning the physical AI revolution.

articles.title: How India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement grew its wings
articles.summary: Young people across India recently made international headlines for mass protests over the recurring leaks of entrance exams that help students qualify for medical schools and highly coveted government jobs. The Gen Z protesters won a major victory within a matter of weeks when Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on July 25, 2026, bowing to [] The post How India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement.

articles.title: New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak
articles.summary: New UN-backed centres will serve eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as confirmed Ebola cases continued to climb sharply over the weekend in the largest ever outbreak of the highly contagious disease in the country. New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak. New UN-partnered centres will serve eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as confirmed Ebola cases continued to climb sharply over the weekend in the largest-ever outbreak of the highly contagious disease in the country.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Hub, This Time In Russia's Vladimir Region
articles.summary: Ukraine has launched another drone strike targeting a Wildberries warehouse overnight on August 3, according to Russian authorities. The attack in the Vladimir region is part of a broader campaign in recent weeks that has repeatedly hit the logistics network of Russia's largest online retailer. Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Hub, This Time In Russia's Vladimir Region.

articles.title: Russian Logistics Sites Targeted Again As Zelenskyy Urges Faster Patriot Deliveries
articles.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchanged another wave of overnight drone strikes targeting logistics, energy, and civilian infrastructure, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy voiced frustration with Western allies over delays in delivering urgently needed Patriot air defense systems and other military aid. Russian Logistics Sites Targeted Again As Zelenskyy Urges Faster Patriot Deliveries.

articles.title: Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi
articles.summary: Sofia* was 27, raising her seven-year-old son alone in Venezuela, and running out of options. For years she had distributed personal hygiene products door to door, but as her customers’ finances collapsed, so did her income. Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi.

articles.summary: Red Sea: मिडिल ईस्ट में तनाव लगातार बढ़ता जा रहा है। अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच बढ़ते तनाव के बीच लाल सागर और होर्मुज की खाड़ी में हालात बहुत नाजुक हो गए हैं। यमन के हूती विद्रोहियों ने लाल सागर में सऊदी अरब के एक बड़े तेल टैंकर पर मिसाइल से हमला कर दिया है। हूती विद्रोहियों का दावा है कि समुद्र में नाकेबंदी के तहत उन्होंने पिछले 13 दिनों में 8वें जहाज को निशाना बनाया है।
